descriptions.preferred: The large leaves of 'Samidare', whose name means "early summer rain," are of heavy texture and firm to the touch. When first unfolding in early spring, the tiny leaves are almost pink. Quite soon they turn a rich green with margins a light reddish tone. During summer the deep green holds well without burning, even in full sun. In the fall, a gold-green center develops, with the lobes turning purplish. Other combinations of gold and crimson blend in different leaves. The leaves have seven lobes, occasionally five lobes, and measure 6-8 cm long and 8-12 cm wide. The lobes radiate sharply outward and are strongly ovate, terminating in a blunt tip. They join less than halfway to the leaf base, making a large palm-shaped leaf. The margins are very finely toothed, almost smooth, with the outer third slightly larger toothed. The petioles are slender, firm, and 3. 5-7 cm long. This hardy cultivar has thick and stiff twigs and young branches. It grows rapidly and upright at first but soon makes a short, broad tree as it slows down. It eventually reaches up to 6 m high and broad. It is a very durable garden plant which adds good color.

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Samidare' 的叶片较大，名称意为“初夏之雨”，叶质厚实，触感坚挺。 早春初展时，幼叶几乎呈粉色；不久即转为浓绿色，叶缘带浅红色调。 夏季深绿色保持良好，即使全日照下也不易灼伤。 秋季叶中心发展出金绿色，裂片则转为带紫色；不同叶片上还会交织出金色与深红色等其他色彩组合。 叶片通常七裂，偶为五裂，长 6-8 厘米、宽 8-12 厘米。 裂片明显向外辐射，呈强烈卵形，端部较钝；裂片连接处不到叶片长度的一半，因此形成宽大的掌状叶。 叶缘锯齿极细，近乎平滑，仅外侧三分之一处的锯齿略明显。 叶柄细长而坚实，长 3. 5-7 厘米。 该品种耐性好，嫩枝和幼枝粗壮而坚硬。 初期生长迅速且直立，随后生长放缓，逐渐形成矮而宽的小乔木，最终可达高宽各 6 米。 它是极为耐久的园艺品种，能为庭园提供良好的色彩表现。
